notices.title: Fair play
notices.text: Stones no longer wait forever, idle bearers step aside, and the fellowship can vote. Read it all in the Wayglass under What's new.

notices.title: Hear ye!
notices.text: Thank you for Playing Lanternhall! I hope you enjoy the game and feel free to send any feedback in your wayglass! Travel on Ye Adventurer! 💪🏃
